subtasks.description: Declare the 256-entry AES inverse S-box lookup table as a constant read-only resource. The table must hold the 8-bit output values for all 256 input bytes, with values matching the standard AES inverse S-box definition.
constraints: Table must contain exactly 256 entries of 8 bits each.
Use flat scalar/packed vector representation to avoid unpacked arrays and multidimensional references. Do not use generate/genvar constructs.

subtasks.description: Read byte_in and drive byte_out by indexing into the constant inverse S-box table declared in B1. This is a purely combinational path with no clock, reset, or sequential logic.
constraints: Use a combinational assignment or always @* block.
Avoid unpacked arrays; access the table using flattened bit indexing if a packed vector is used.
